summary: Defers UNSET normalization, but the post-parse loop assigns UNSET back to itself instead of None, so UNSET leaks into user commands.

findings.explanation: The loop `if value is UNSET: ctx.params[name] = UNSET` is a no-op. The comment and the removed code say UNSET must become None, so any parameter left unset now passes the `Sentinel.UNSET` object to the command function.
